name: feedback-to-roadmap
description: Pulls recent customer feedback from your support desk and a feedback channel in chat (plus anything you paste), clusters it into roadmap themes with item counts, distinct customers, an ARR-weighted score from the CRM, a trend and verbatim customer quotes, flags churn signals, and links each theme to the existing tracker issues that already cover it. Read-only: it never creates or edits an issue and never posts anywhere; a drafted issue is copyable text. Ask for "feedback themes from the last 30 days". Not a call transcript miner and not a general support assistant.

skills.name: Turn customer feedback into roadmap themes
skills.description: Reads support tickets and chat feedback from a window (default 30 days), clusters them into themes with counts, customers, ARR-weighted share, trend and quotes, and links each theme to existing tracker issues.
examples: Feedback themes from the last 30 days
